evals.name: parsed-output-is-raw
evals.prompt: A follow-up operation will parse git status --porcelain. We have an rtk Bash rewrite hook. Choose the command form, without running it.
evals.expected_output: Use rtk proxy git status --porcelain so exact paths and status are preserved rather than compressed.
assertions: Uses rtk proxy for the parsed output.
Explains that summaries can drop exact state.
Does not treat compression as gate evidence.

evals.name: wrapped-failure-and-exit-code
evals.prompt: A wrapped test command printed 0 errors but exited nonzero. Can we report a pass or pipe the retry into head? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Report failure, inspect raw diagnostics through rtk proxy, preserve the producer exit status, and never use a filtered summary as proof.
assertions: Does not report a pass from the zero-error text.
Uses raw diagnostics for the wrapped failure.
Rejects head/grep gate evidence and preserves the real exit code.

evals.name: optional-tool-and-native-ci
evals.prompt: rtk is not installed here. Should we install it to unblock work and add its wrappers to CI? Reply only.
evals.expected_output: Use normal tools without installing or blocking; keep native commands in CI and follow the existing gate contract.
assertions: Continues with normal tools when rtk is absent.
Keeps scripts/hooks/CI native rather than changing their commands.
